secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Lovable workspace API key — needed for AI chat, voice (speak/transcribe), explain, and work features. Get it from the Lovable dashboard (Project Settings → API).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations (bypasses RLS). Get it from the Supabase dashboard (Project Settings → API → service_role).

secrets.name: OAUTH_STATE_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret for signing OAuth state tokens. Any random 32+ char string works.

secrets.name: APP_USER_CONNECTION_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key for encrypting app-user connection keys. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32.
